entries.desc: On a wrapper-root fixture (metadataRoot != gitRoot), buildDoneChecklist git-working-tree row reads clean instead of fail/blocking after threading doneGitCwd through runDonePreMergeGate->runDoneOracleGate->buildDoneChecklist->readGitStatusLines

evidence.note: Wrapper-root smoke: with resolved gitCwd (real gitRoot) the git-working-tree done-check row reads clean/pass; red baseline (bare metadataRoot) was fail/blocking in the same run. Witness: neutering the fix flipped GREEN assertion to status=fail detail=fatal: not a git repository.

entries.desc: On a plain repo (projectRoot==gitCwd, no distinct gitRoot), the git-working-tree row + all done-oracle git calls are byte-identical before/after (root fallback preserves behavior)

evidence.note: Plain-repo byte-identity: smoke proof drives buildDoneChecklist on a plain repo (metadataRoot==gitRoot) with gitCwd absent vs {gitCwd:root} and assert.deepEqual on the full row set + git-working-tree row — identical (root fallback preserves behavior).

entries.desc: resolveGitCwd is resolved ONCE at the boundary (the same doneGitCwd at transition-orchestrator:271 used by autoSync) and passed down — not re-resolved divergently inside the gate; lattice validate stays green

evidence.note: doneGitCwd resolved ONCE at transition-orchestrator (the SAME value used by autoSyncMain:298 + checkMainDivergence:295) and threaded into runDonePreMergeGate(...,doneGitCwd) at :371 — no re-resolution inside the gate chain (preMortem #4). lattice validate --story=B-6666 PASS.

entries.desc: On a wrapper-root fixture, evidence-freshness git probes (currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash via checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit) return defined hashes instead of undefined after the resolved gitCwd is threaded into the probes (caller boundary or gitCwd param), so the done-path evidence-freshness row is computed against the real gitRoot

evidence.note: Wrapper-root smoke: evidence-freshness probes (currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash via checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit) return DEFINED hashes against the resolved inner gitRoot; bare metadataRoot returned undefined (red baseline in same run).

entries.desc: On a plain repo, currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/changedFilesBetween results are byte-identical before/after (root fallback)

evidence.note: Plain-repo probe byte-identity: currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash outputs identical bare-root vs resolved gitCwd (root fallback).

entries.desc: The done-path evidence-freshness caller (buildDoneChecklist:280 checkEvidenceFreshness) receives the SAME resolved gitCwd as the git-status row (no split-brain between the two done-oracle git reads); validate green

evidence.note: done-oracle.ts:280 checkEvidenceFreshness receives the SAME buildDoneChecklist-threaded resolved gitCwd as the git-status row — no split-brain. Confessional comment + no-op aliases removed from evidence-freshness.ts (grep returns 0). validate PASS.

entries.desc: After strengthening, npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract exits 0 and prints the passed banner, with all confirmed bare-root sites fixed (done-oracle + evidence-freshness now route through resolveGitCwd)

evidence.note: Contract exits 0 (GREEN): repo scan 520 .ts files 0 bare-cwd violations; done-oracle + evidence-freshness now route through resolveGitCwd; deferred sites documented in DEFERRED_ALLOWLIST_EXACT with B-99b6 burndown follow-up, original B-db56 literal-git coverage preserved for them via isOldRegexVisible.

entries.desc: A KNOWN-BAD self-test fixture: a no-op const gitCwd=projectRoot alias used as a git cwd WITHOUT resolveGitCwd produces exactly 1 violation; a KNOWN-GOOD fixture (alias not used as git cwd, OR routed via resolveGitCwd) produces 0 violations — alias rule pinned both ways

evidence.note: Self-tests pin alias rule both ways: ALIAS KNOWN-BAD (const gitCwd=projectRoot used as git cwd) = exactly 1 violation; ALIAS KNOWN-GOOD (const x=projectRoot NOT a git cwd) = 0; ALIAS KNOWN-GOOD (const gitCwd=resolveGitCwd(...)) = 0. Proximity-scoped to git-call window (preMortem #3).

entries.desc: A KNOWN-BAD self-test fixture: a backtick-template execSync(`git ...`) with cwd:projectRoot is flagged (the old GIT_CALL_REGEX backtick blind spot is closed); reintroducing either gaming shape (the exact d93b69b8f alias) turns the contract RED

evidence.note: BACKTICK KNOWN-BAD (execSync(`git`,{cwd:projectRoot})) flagged; KNOWN-GOOD (cwd:resolvedGitCwd) = 0. LIVE red->green witness: injected const witnessGitCwd=projectRoot;execSync(`git status`,{cwd:witnessGitCwd}) into done-oracle.ts -> contract exit 1 flagging the d93b69b8f shape -> revert -> exit 0.
